fusions.name: Scent Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a scale at the first enemy it meets, dealing 5 damage with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry Marker
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 34 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Bosses and elites take a further 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Fall In Behind
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more power for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Run-Down Resolve
fusions.desc: Against afflicted enemies, your damage rises by 12% and your armour by 6%.
